{{Quote|As Rukil told us, it is not an easy life. Our children will grow up in a world of spears and bows, not blasters and starships.|[[Baral]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Bows''' were primitive weapons that fired [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]] used for [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]], sport, or combat. Advanced versions were also made for high-tech worlds.

==Description==
An ancient design used thousands of years prior to the introduction of blaster weapons, bows were eclipsed by newer technology. Many primitive races still used them to great effect, whether for hunting food or killing enemies.

Bows on low-tech worlds were often made of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] with [[Stone/Legends|stone]] or [[Metal/Legends|metal]] enhancements, while bows on high-tech worlds could be constructed of durable, lightweight composite materials. The user's strength could affect the range and power of the weapon.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Depending on the construction of the bow, as well as the user's strength, the maximum range of a bow was roughly 66 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. However, bows that where made for non-humans, such as the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Pulley bow]], could propel an arrow much farther, and with far more force than bows built for humans.

==History==
[[File:Onderon_-_Bow_hunting.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Onderon/Legends|Onderonians]] hunting with bows.]]
During the [[Ruusan campaign]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Petja]] used a bow, despite the availability of modern blasters. His reason for such a preference is unknown. While hunting [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Guun Han Saresh]] used a more advanced compound bow to kill an animal for use as bait.

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] demonstrated the effectiveness of bows in combating [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Using tactical advantages to their cause&mdash;height, surprise attack, numbers&mdash;the Ewoks could rival the stormtroopers' advanced weaponry, and felled many Imperials. However, many Ewoks still died from Imperial counterfire. Even [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used a bow when hunting [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]], better known as The Butcher of [[Montellian Serat/Legends|Montellian Serat]]. He knew his opponent had highly-sensitive sensor equipment that would detect any of his "normal" weapons. Similarly, bows could be seen on high-tech planets used for sport.
